# 1 Enoch Chapter 53 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**53:1** And there my eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, and all who dwell on the earth and on the sea and on the islands shall bring to it gifts and presents and tokens of homage, but that deep valley shall not become full.

**53:2** And their hands commit lawless deeds, and the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress; yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of the Lord of Spirits, and they shall be banished from the face of his earth, and they shall perish forever and ever.

**53:3** For I saw all the angels of punishment abiding there and preparing all the instruments of Satan.

**53:4** And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: "For whom are they preparing these instruments?"

**53:5** And he said to me: "They are being prepared for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that they may be destroyed by them."

**53:6** "And after this the Righteous and Elect One shall cause the house of his congregation to appear: from that time forward they shall be hindered no more in the name of the Lord of Spirits."

**53:7** And these mountains shall not stand before his righteousness as they stand before the earth, but the hills shall be as a fountain of water, and the righteous shall have rest from the oppression of sinners.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Good consensus. Key decisions: "deep valley with open mouths" (LOGOS) — "gaping mouths" (PNEUMA) is vivid but adds an adjective not in the Ge'ez. "Tokens of homage" (LOGOS) over PNEUMA's "tokens of submission" — "homage" captures the ritual tribute sense better. Combined title "Righteous and Elect One" (v. 6) preserved from all agents. See disagreement log.*
